messages.subject: annotation question
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

At what step do you recommend annotation?  I am assuming that it is best to annotate lipids after quality control, alignment, peak picking, ROI selection etc because then you have fewer to annotate.  And I am planning to use lipid maps next.  I tried using Waters's annotation method,  but I am getting few annotated peaks (and unfortunately none of the statistically significant ones).  I know this is a known issue in lipidomics, but is there some other package/database that works better?

Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks,
Nadia

messages.subject: Cardinal imzML compatibility with MZmine
messages.body_plain:
Hi all,

I am trying to use MZmine3 for annotation queries after processing with Cardinal.

I have tried to save imzML files with a number of ways/params with writeMSIData <https://rdrr.io/bioc/Cardinal/man/writeMSIData.html>() and writeImzML <https://rdrr.io/bioc/Cardinal/man/writeMSIData.html>(), but  they are all incompatible with MZmine3. I get the error: "I: Scans were detected as centroid but contain zero intensity values."

imzML files from METASPACE and SCiLS are successfully imported into MZmine3.

has anyone tried this and have suggestions? is there a way to compare the internal structured of imzML files?

thank you in advance!
